selected_api.abi: Four existing C int state representations in a new return struct. The existing PiUvFsInfo, opaque PiUvFsRequest layout and every existing signature remain unchanged; Zig obtains the new declaration through the same canonical native_uv_fs.h cImport.
selected_api.precondition: The caller retains the request and owns its unsubmitted dispatch-thread phase, before first admission or after successful Reset, without concurrent admission/cleanup/reset/release.
selected_api.not_synchronization: The non-atomic submitted guard and kind/accepted reads rely on the caller's existing phase ownership. The API makes no thread-owner verification or concurrent snapshot claim.
